PRINT IN PLACE FLEXI PARASAUROLOPHUS DINOSAUR ARTICULATED
Hey everyone, how are you all doing? Today, we have an exciting announcement for all you dinosaur lovers! We’re thrilled to introduce a new dinosaur from Toonzfactory's dinosaur lineup. Hello, everyone! I hope you're all doing well. Today, I've got something new for you that I think you're going to love. So, without further ado, let me present to you our new design - Flexi CopperHead Snake—a design that's bound to capture all your hearts. Get ready to fall in love with it!
We have created the Copperhead Snake in two versions: one without a tongue, and one with a tongue. In the second version, you can print the body and tongue separately and then glue them together.
The Copperhead Snake is known for its distinctive copper-colored head and patterned body, making it both striking and easily recognizable. It’s a venomous snake found primarily in North America, often blending into its surroundings with its natural camouflage. Despite its venom, it’s generally non-aggressive and will avoid confrontation if possible.
Now, moving on to the design itself -We've created this design in three parts: body, head, and tail. The body has two ball sockets where you can attach the head and tail, allowing you to print this design as large as you'd like. it's a print-in-place, no-supports, fully flexible design that you can easily print without any additional support. description_text:
English Description:The Realistic Tyrannosaurus Rex Skeleton Model is a scientifically accurate and meticulously detailed 3D representation of the iconic T-Rex fossil. Ideal for museum exhibits, educational animations, scientific visualizations, and dinosaur-themed projects, this model features every major bone structure including the massive skull, ribcage, spine, limbs, and tail with lifelike proportion and anatomical accuracy. Perfect for high-quality renders, VR simulations, or paleontology-focused media. Available in FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND formats for maximum compatibility with all major 3D platforms.
German Description:Das Realistic Tyrannosaurus Rex Skeleton Modell ist eine wissenschaftlich präzise und äußerst detaillierte 3D-Darstellung des ikonischen T-Rex-Skeletts. Ideal für Museumsausstellungen, Bildungsanimationen, wissenschaftliche Visualisierungen und Dinosaurier-Projekte. Das Modell umfasst alle wichtigen Knochenstrukturen – darunter der massive Schädel, Brustkorb, Wirbelsäule, Gliedmaßen und Schwanz – in lebensnaher Proportion und anatomischer Genauigkeit. Perfekt für hochwertige Renderings, VR-Simulationen oder paläontologische Medien. Verfügbar in FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ und BLEND.
Polish Description:Realistyczny Model Szkieletu Tyranozaura Rex to szczegółowa i naukowo wierna reprezentacja 3D znanego szkieletu T-Rexa. Idealny do ekspozycji muzealnych, animacji edukacyjnych, wizualizacji naukowych oraz projektów o tematyce dinozaurów. Zawiera wszystkie główne struktury kostne, w tym czaszkę, klatkę piersiową, kręgosłup, kończyny i ogon, odwzorowane z zachowaniem realistycznych proporcji. Dostępny w formatach FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ i BLEND, kompatybilny z wszystkimi głównymi platformami 3D.
Arabic Description:نموذج هيكل عظمي واقعي للديناصور تي-ريكس هو تمثيل ثلاثي الأبعاد دقيق علميًا ومفصل للغاية للحفرية الشهيرة. مثالي للمعارض المتحفية، الرسوم المتحركة التعليمية، التصورات العلمية أو المشاريع التي تتناول الديناصورات. يشمل جميع أجزاء الهيكل الرئيسية مثل الجمجمة الكبيرة، القفص الصدري، العمود الفقري، الأطراف والذيل، مع دقة تشريحية كاملة. مناسب للعروض عالية الجودة، المحاكاة في الواقع الافتراضي أو الوسائط المتخصصة في علم الحفريات. متاح بصيغ FBX وOBJ وSTL وGLB وUSDZ وBLEND.
Chinese Description:真实版霸王龙骨骼模型是一款科学严谨且高度细节化的3D模型，再现了这只史前巨兽的化石结构。非常适合用于博物馆展示、教育动画、科学可视化以及恐龙主题项目。模型包括主要骨骼结构，如巨大头骨、肋骨、脊柱、四肢和尾巴，比例真实、结构准确。支持 FBX、OBJ、STL、GLB、USDZ 和 BLEND 格式，兼容所有主流3D平台。
Korean Description:리얼리스틱 티라노사우루스 렉스 골격 모델은 고생물학적으로 정확하고 정교하게 설계된 3D 공룡 화석 모델입니다. 박물관 전시, 교육용 애니메이션, 과학 시각화, 공룡 테마 콘텐츠에 이상적입니다. 거대한 두개골, 갈비뼈, 척추, 팔다리, 꼬리 등 주요 뼈 구조가 현실적인 비율과 해부학적 정확성을 바탕으로 구현되어 있습니다. FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, BLEND 형식으로 제공되며 모든 주요 3D 플랫폼과 호환됩니다.
Turkish Description:Gerçekçi Tyrannosaurus Rex İskelet Modeli, ünlü T-Rex fosilinin bilimsel olarak doğru ve son derece detaylı bir 3D temsilidir. Müzeler, eğitim animasyonları, bilimsel görselleştirmeler ve dinozor temalı projeler için idealdir. Devasa kafatası, kaburga, omurga, uzuvlar ve kuyruk dahil tüm temel kemik yapıları gerçekçi oranda ve anatomik doğrulukla modellenmiştir. Yüksek kaliteli renderlar, VR simülasyonları veya paleontoloji odaklı medyalar için uygundur. FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ ve BLEND formatlarında sunulur.
French Description:Le modèle réaliste du squelette de Tyrannosaurus Rex est une sculpture 3D d’une grande précision scientifique et riche en détails, représentant le célèbre fossile. Parfait pour les expositions muséales, animations éducatives, visualisations scientifiques ou projets sur le thème des dinosaures. Il comprend toutes les structures osseuses principales – crâne massif, cage thoracique, colonne vertébrale, membres et queue – avec des proportions fidèles et une anatomie exacte. Disponible aux formats FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ et BLEND.

description_text:
Inspired by prehistoric archaeological digs and everybody's favorite King Kaiju, Skullzilla features a fun and original design and the trendy flexi joint system beloved by customers. He has a wide range of motion at every joint, located at the neck, all four limbs, the torso, the hips, and three tail joints. He has a balanced equilibrium to allow for both a standing position and a tummy lying position.
I printed him to be 6 inches long when lying down, but you could feasibly print him smaller or larger, whatever you prefer. Settings are fairly standard. description_text:
Here is the NEWEST STL/3MF to the Gigantuan Design library, Kaijoo Deng, the loveable pygmy hippo kaiju!
She was originally a meme created by community content creator and Gigantuan Design ambassador @b1tchzilla on instagram, and I have been wanting a figure ever since. With her permission, I was able to turn this adorable meme into a physical print. I hope I did her justice!
Since this is a multicolor print, your mileage may vary. I printed this as a 4 color file, 6 inches long (that's 127mm), and it took me just under 9 hours to print on my X1C. I have included both a 4 color and 5 color file, the 5 color file including the pupils, which I just hand painted black. If you add a 5th color change, it may take longer. A one color print, of course, would probably take less than half the print time a 4 color would.
While this is a print in place, I do suggest manually adding supports under the chin. Do NOT autosupport, as it will try to support the joints, which will cause joint fusion and render poor Kaijoo Deng motionless.
Same standard print settings as usual. I printed it at .2 layer height, 15% infill, rectilinear infill (although gyroid would probably work as well), with manual supports UNDER THE CHIN ONLY and no brim. You could feasibly print this with a smaller layer height for detail reasons at the expense of adding print time.
I can't wait to see your Kaijoo Deng prints!

description_text:
Detailed 3D model of a Spinosaurus Skeleton. This model accurately represents the skeletal structure of Spinosaurus aegyptiacus, one of the largest carnivorous dinosaurs known for the distinctive sail-like structure on its back. The model showcases the key bones of a Spinosaurus skeleton, including the long skull with its narrow snout and conical teeth, the relatively short neck, the elongated neural spines forming the prominent sail along its back, the robust rib cage, the powerful forelimbs with large claws, the strong hindlimbs, and the long tail. The model incorporates current paleontological understanding, including potential adaptations for a semi-aquatic lifestyle. This 3D model is ideal for use in paleontology education, dinosaur-themed projects, museum exhibits (virtual or physical), scientific research, or any project requiring a detailed and accurate skeletal representation of Spinosaurus. The model is provided in multiple formats: FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of 3D software and platforms.

Bu model, sırtında kendine özgü yelken benzeri yapısıyla bilinen en büyük etçil dinozorlardan biri olan Spinosaurus aegyptiacus'un iskelet yapısını doğru bir şekilde temsil eder. French Description:
Modèle 3D détaillé d'un Squelette de Spinosaurus. Ce modèle représente avec précision la structure squelettique de Spinosaurus aegyptiacus, l'un des plus grands dinosaures carnivores connus pour la structure distinctive en forme de voile sur son dos. Le modèle met en évidence les os clés du squelette de Spinosaurus, y compris le long crâne avec son museau étroit et ses dents coniques, le cou relativement court, les épines neurales allongées formant la voile proéminente le long de son dos, la cage thoracique robuste, les membres antérieurs puissants avec de grandes griffes, les membres postérieurs forts et la longue queue. Le modèle intègre la compréhension paléontologique actuelle, y compris les adaptations potentielles à un mode de vie semi-aquatique. Ce modèle 3D est idéal pour une utilisation dans l'enseignement de la paléontologie, les projets sur le thème des dinosaures, les expositions muséales (virtuelles ou physiques), la recherche scientifique ou tout projet nécessitant une représentation squelettique détaillée et précise de Spinosaurus. Le modèle est fourni en plusieurs formats : FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ et BLEND, assurant la compatibilité avec une large gamme de logiciels et de plateformes 3D.

description_text:
Concise 3D model of a Draco Lizard gliding. Depicts a Draco lizard (also known as a flying lizard) in a gliding pose, with its patagia (wing-like membranes) extended. Showcases its flattened body and the colorful membranes supported by elongated ribs, allowing it to glide between trees in its Southeast Asian habitat. Known for its insectivorous diet. Suitable for wildlife, nature, Southeast Asian fauna, and educational visualizations. Available in FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND formats.
İngilizce Anahtar Kelimeler:

Almanca Beschreibung:
Kurzes 3D-Modell eines gleitenden Drachenleguans. Zeigt einen Draco-Leguan (auch bekannt als Flugdrache) in einer Gleitpose, mit ausgebreiteten Patagia (flügelartigen Membranen). Präsentiert seinen abgeflachten Körper und die farbenprächtigen Membranen, die von verlängerten Rippen getragen werden und es ihm ermöglichen, in seinem südostasiatischen Lebensraum zwischen Bäumen zu gleiten. Bekannt für seine insektenfressende Ernährung. Geeignet für Visualisierungen von Wildtieren, Natur, südostasiatischer Fauna und für Bildungszwecke. Verfügbar in den Formaten FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ und BLEND.

Lehcze Opis:
Krótki model 3D Szybującego Latającego Smoka. Przedstawia latającego smoka (Draco) w pozycji szybującej, z rozpostartymi patagiami (błonami przypominającymi skrzydła). Ukazuje jego spłaszczone ciało i kolorowe błony podtrzymywane przez wydłużone żebra, co pozwala mu szybować między drzewami w jego środowisku naturalnym w Azji Południowo-Wschodniej. Znany z diety owadożernej. Nadaje się do wizualizacji dzikiej przyrody, natury, fauny Azji Południowo-Wschodniej i edukacyjnych. Dostępny w formatach FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ i BLEND.

نموذج ثلاثي الأبعاد موجز لسحلية التنين وهي تنزلق. يصور سحلية التنين (Draco) (المعروفة أيضًا باسم السحلية الطائرة) في وضعية انزلاق، مع فرد أغشيتها الجلدية (patagia) الشبيهة بالأجنحة. يعرض جسمها المسطح والأغشية الملونة المدعومة بأضلاع ممدودة، مما يسمح لها بالانزلاق بين الأشجار في موطنها بجنوب شرق آسيا. معروفة بنظامها الغذائي الحشري. مناسب لتصورات الحياة البرية والطبيعة والحيوانات في جنوب شرق آسيا والتعليمية. متوفر بتنسيقات FBX و OBJ و STL و GLB و USDZ و BLEND.

飞蜥滑翔的简洁 3D 模型。描绘了一只处于滑翔姿势的飞蜥 (Draco)，其翼膜（翼状膜）已展开。展示了其扁平的身体以及由细长的肋骨支撑的彩色膜，使其能够在东南亚栖息地的树木之间滑翔。以其食虫性饮食而闻名。适用于野生动物、自然、东南亚动物群和教育可视化。提供 FBX、OBJ、STL、GLB、USDZ 和 BLEND 格式。

description_text:
Güneşlenen Boynuzlu Kertenkele'nin kısa 3D modeli. Güneşlenirkenki bir Boynuzlu Kertenkele'nin (cins Phrynosoma) 3D temsilini tasvir eder. Boynuzlu kertenkeleler, yassı vücutları, dikenli pulları ve başlarındaki belirgin boynuzlarıyla bilinen bir Kuzey Amerika kertenkeleleri grubudur. Güneşlenme, kertenkelenin ısıyı emmek ve vücut sıcaklığını düzenlemek için güneşte yatması davranışıdır. Model, kertenkeleyi bir yüzeyin üzerinde düz bir şekilde yatarken, muhtemelen güneş ışığını en üst düzeye çıkaracak şekilde yönlendirilmiş olarak gösterecektir. Farklı pul türleri, genellikle çevreyle uyum sağlayan renklenme ve boynuzların boyutu ve şekli gibi detaylar görünür olmalıdır. Bu model, sürüngenler hakkında eğitim materyalleri, vahşi yaşam görselleştirmeleri, zoolojik çalışmalar ve doğal yaşam alanlarını (Kuzey ve Orta Amerika'nın kurak ve yarı kurak bölgeleri) tasvir eden sanal ortamlar için uygundur. FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ ve BLEND formatlarında mevcuttur.

İngilizce Açıklama:
Concise 3D model of a Horned Lizard basking. Depicts a Horned Lizard (genus Phrynosoma) in a basking pose. Known for their flattened bodies, spiky scales, and prominent horns, horned lizards bask in the sun to regulate their body temperature. The model showcases the lizard lying flat on a surface, likely oriented to maximize sun exposure. Details such as the various types of scales, the camouflage coloration, and the size and shape of the horns are visible. Suitable for educational materials about reptiles, wildlife visualizations, zoological studies, and virtual environments depicting their natural habitat (arid and semi-arid regions of North and Central America). Available in FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND formats.

Almanca Beschreibung:
Kurzes 3D-Modell eines sonnenbadenden Hornleguans. Zeigt einen Hornleguan (Gattung Phrynosoma) in einer sonnenbadenden Pose. Hornleguane sind bekannt für ihren abgeflachten Körper, ihre stacheligen Schuppen und ihre markanten Hörner. Sie sonnen sich, um ihre Körpertemperatur zu regulieren. Das Modell zeigt die Eidechse flach auf einer Oberfläche liegend, wahrscheinlich so ausgerichtet, dass die Sonneneinstrahlung maximiert wird. Details wie die verschiedenen Arten von Schuppen, die Tarnfärbung sowie Größe und Form der Hörner sind sichtbar. Geeignet für Bildungsmaterialien über Reptilien, Wildtier-Visualisierungen, zoologische Studien und virtuelle Umgebungen, die ihren natürlichen Lebensraum (trockene und halbtrockene Regionen Nord- und Mittelamerikas) darstellen. Verfügbar in den Formaten FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ und BLEND.

Lehcze Opis:
Krótki model 3D Wygrzewającej się Rogatej Jaszczurki. Przedstawia jaszczurkę rogatą (rodzaj Phrynosoma) w pozie wygrzewania się na słońcu. Rogate jaszczurki, znane z płaskich ciał, kolczastych łusek i charakterystycznych rogów, wygrzewają się na słońcu, aby regulować temperaturę ciała. Model ukazuje jaszczurkę leżącą płasko na powierzchni, prawdopodobnie skierowaną tak, aby zmaksymalizować ekspozycję na słońce. Widoczne są detale takie jak różne rodzaje łusek, kamuflażowe ubarwienie oraz rozmiar i kształt rogów. Nadaje się do materiałów edukacyjnych o gadach, wizualizacji dzikiej przyrody, badań zoologicznych oraz do wirtualnych środowisk przedstawiających ich naturalne siedliska (pustynne i półpustynne regiony Ameryki Północnej i Środkowej). Dostępny w formatach FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ i BLEND.

description_text: This Greek Fisherman’s Hat Package is based on the Aegean Greek Fisherman’s cap. This cap is renowned for its iconic look. It’s been called a fiddler cap, a Mao cap as well as s Breton cap. The style is usually worn in black, navy blue wool or tan corduroy. Our Greek Fisherman’s Hat is fully customizable with multiple color options. It was designed for a standard height figure (186 cm) in Cinema 4D and Zbrush. This package is ideal for game assets, illustration, and animation. It’s sized for standard figures in Unity, Poser or Daz Studio. I’ve broken the model down into its basic components for ease of customization. This Greek Fisherman’s Hat Package can be used in a variety of programs. Images created in Cinema 4D and Marmoset Toolbag. Figure and lighting set not included. I’ve included the file formats:• 3DS• OBJ (medium, high)• FBX • MAX• STL• ZTL • C4D• 3D COATThe package offers three color styles; black, navy blue and tan. The mesh comes in high and medium polygon options to fit your needs. The 3DS Max version and the Cinema 4D version allow for mesh smoothing. Textures are included in 2048x2048 for clear resolution. The package includes the following maps:• Diffuse• Normal• Fresnel• Reflectance• RoughnessThe package is presented in zip format. This requires an unzipping tool which most computers have as standard application. Use the appropriate format into your favorite 3D modeling program and customize the textures. The Greek Fisherman’s Hat Package models come pre-UV mapped along with a handy bitmap template from which to layout your own textures. Feel free to drop your suggestions to me for both realistic and fantasy style headgear.Be sure to check out the other models in my gallery. I’m always adding more models, so check back regularly; just click on my user name.

description_text:
This Safari Hat Package is based on the headwear that hunters and fishermen wear when they head out into the woods. The hat is perfect for men and women.  This asset is perfect for leisure time characters or 3D printing enthusiasts.Our Safari Hat Package is fully customizable. The template included in the package allows you to add your own custom color options. It was designed for a standard height figure (186 cm) in Cinema 4D and Zbrush. This package is ideal for game assets, illustration, and animation. It’s sized for standard figures in Unity, Poser or Daz Studio. I’ve broken the model down into its basic components for ease of customization. This Safari Hat Package can be used in a variety of programs. I’ve included the file formats:

  - 3DS

  - DFX

  - OBJ (medium, high)

  - FBX 

  - MAX

  - STL

  - ZTL 

  - C4D

  - 3D COATThe package offers textures and two obj files. The mesh comes in high and medium polygon options to fit your needs. The 3DS Max version and the Cinema 4D version allow for mesh smoothing. Textures are included in 2048x2048 for clear resolution. The package includes the following maps:

  - Diffuse

  - Normal

  - Fresnel

  - Reflectance

  - RoughnessThe package is presented in zip format. This requires an unzipping tool which most computers have as standard application. Use the appropriate format into your favorite 3D modeling program and customize the textures. The TEX folder contains the textures that come with these models.The Safari Hat Package models come pre-UV mapped along with a handy bitmap template from which to layout your own textures. Feel free to drop your suggestions to me for both realistic and fantasy style headgear.Be sure to check out the other models in my gallery. I’m always adding more models, so check back regularly; just click on my user name.

description_text:
The octopus (plural octopuses) is a soft-bodied, eight-limbed mollusc of the order Octopoda (/ɒkˈtɒpədə/, ok-TO-pə-də). Around 300 species are recognised, and the order is grouped within the class Cephalopoda with squids, cuttlefish, and nautiloids. Like other cephalopods, the octopus is bilaterally symmetric with two eyes and a beak, with its mouth at the center point of the eight limbs (tentacle is used as an umbrella term for cephalopod limbs; however, within a teuthological context, arm is used to refer to such limbs while tentacle is reserved for feeding appendages not found on octopuses). The soft body can rapidly alter its shape, enabling octopuses to squeeze through small gaps. They trail their eight appendages behind them as they swim. The siphon is used both for respiration and for locomotion, by expelling a jet of water. Octopuses have a complex nervous system and excellent sight, and are among the most intelligent and behaviourally diverse of all invertebrates.
Octopuses inhabit various regions of the ocean, including coral reefs, pelagic waters, and the seabed; some live in the intertidal zone and others at abyssal depths. Most species grow quickly, mature early, and are short-lived. In most species, the male uses a specially adapted arm to deliver a bundle of sperm directly into the female's mantle cavity, after which he becomes senescent and dies, while the female deposits fertilised eggs in a den and cares for them until they hatch, after which she also dies. Strategies to defend themselves against predators include the expulsion of ink, the use of camouflage and threat displays, the ability to jet quickly through the water and hide, and even deceit. All octopuses are venomous, but only the blue-ringed octopuses are known to be deadly to humans.
Octopuses appear in mythology as sea monsters like the Kraken of Norway and the Akkorokamui of the Ainu, and probably the Gorgon of ancient Greece. A battle with an octopus appears in Victor Hugo's book Toilers of the Sea, inspiring other works such as Ian Fleming's Octopussy. Octopuses appear in Japanese art, shunga. They are eaten and considered a delicacy by humans in many parts of the world, especially the Mediterranean and the Asian seas.

description_text:
A boat is a watercraft of a large range of types and sizes, but generally smaller than a ship, which is distinguished by its larger size, shape, cargo or passenger capacity, or its ability to carry boats.
Small boats are typically found on inland waterways such as rivers and lakes, or in protected coastal areas. However, some boats, such as the whaleboat, were intended for use in an offshore environment. In modern naval terms, a boat is a vessel small enough to be carried aboard a ship. Anomalous definitions exist, as lake freighters 1,000 feet (300 m) long on the Great Lakes are called boats.
Boats vary in proportion and construction methods with their intended purpose, available materials, or local traditions. Canoes have been used since prehistoric times and remain in use throughout the world for transportation, fishing, and sport. Fishing boats vary widely in style partly to match local conditions. Pleasure craft used in recreational boating include ski boats, pontoon boats, and sailboats. House boats may be used for vacationing or long-term residence. Lighters are used to convey cargo to and from large ships unable to get close to shore. Lifeboats have rescue and safety functions.
Boats can be propelled by manpower (e.g. rowboats and paddle boats), wind (e.g. sailboats), and motor (including gasoline, diesel, and electric).

description_text:
The Merlion (/ˈmɜːrˌlaɪən/) is the official mascot of Singapore. It is depicted as a mythical creature with the head of a lion and the body of a fish
Merlion[1] (English Merlion, Kit. trad. 魚尾獅, upr. 鱼尾狮, pinyin Yúwěishī, Malay. Singa-Laut, also found transcription Merlion) is a symbol of Singapore, a mythical creature with the body of a fish and the head of a lion. The word Merlion is formed from the words mer (sea, cf. mermaid — mermaid) and lion (lion).[2] The lion symbolizes strength and fearlessness, while Merlion's fish body emphasizes Singapore's close connection with the sea. The name of the city comes from the Sanskrit words singa (lion) and pura (city), as according to one of the legends, the name of the city was given by Prince Sang Nila Utama, who met a lion in the jungle. The prince took out his sword and prepared for battle, but after looking into each other's eyes, the lion and the prince parted in peace without harming each other.
The statue of Merlion in Singapore is based on the emblem of the city, designed in 1964 by Fraser Brunner commissioned by the Singapore Tourism Board. The 8.6-meter-high and 70-ton concrete statue is installed at the mouth of the Singapore River. On September 15, 1972, the opening ceremony of Merlion Park was held, attended by the Prime Minister of Singapore Lee Kuan Yew. On Sentosa Island, there is a 37-meter replica of the original statue in the recreation park.

Nicolas Cage was born Nicolas Kim Coppola in Long Beach, California, the son of comparative literature professor August Coppola (whose brother is director Francis Ford Coppola) and dancer/choreographer Joy Vogelsang. He is of Italian (father) and Polish and German (mother) descent. Cage changed his name early in his career to make his own reputation, succeeding brilliantly with a host of classic, quirky roles by the late 1980s.
Initially studying theatre at Beverly Hills High School (though he dropped out at seventeen), he secured a bit part in Fast Times at Ridgemont High (1982) -- most of which was cut, dashing his hopes and leading to a job selling popcorn at the Fairfax Theater, thinking that would be the only route to a movie career. Bisi bele bath (Sambar Rice) is a popular lunch item in Karnataka. Bisi bele bath is widely available in most restaurants across the state. Bisi bele bath is good to have any time of the day- for breakfast, lunch or dinner.
Rice & Lentil (edible legume or dal) are cooked separately and mixed along with Bisi Bele Bath Masala or powder. This mix is heated for several minutes and stirred regularly to ensure consistency. Bisi Bele Bath masala can be made at home or purchased from stores. Bisi Bele Bath powder is made from fine grinding of chili, cloves, cumin, chana (Bengal gram), cinnamon, coconut, urad dal, coriander seeds and other ingredients. Vegetables such as drumstick, beans, capsicum and chopped carrots are often added to Bisi Bele Bath for enhanced taste.

description_text:
Intended for 3d print.
River-dwelling creatures from japanese folklore.  The name roughly translates to water child or water sprite. Mischievous and malevolent, Kappa were nimble as fish in water but clumsy on land. In fact they carried water from their home river in their bowl-shaped heads, and should the water spill or run out, the Kappa was rendered unable to move at all.
I don't know about you, but from an RPG perspective I think that has huge potential in terms of game mechanics.
This model pack contains 19 unique models (sorry for the typo in the front page image), plus some pond-themed miniature bases. The models are intended for print at 28mm scale. As far as structural integrity goes most models should be printable at smaller scales as well, but details will suffer.
Use the model lineup image, or the images of individual models, to see a visual presentation of all included models.

description_text:
Ants are eusocial insects of the family Formicidae and, along with the related wasps and bees, belong to the order Hymenoptera. Ants appear in the fossil record across the globe in considerable diversity during the latest Early Cretaceous and early Late Cretaceous, suggesting an earlier origin. Ants evolved from vespoid wasp ancestors in the Cretaceous period, and diversified after the rise of flowering plants. More than 12,500 of an estimated total of 22,000 species have been classified. They are easily identified by their elbowed antennae and the distinctive node-like structure that forms their slender waists.
Ants form colonies that range in size from a few dozen predatory individuals living in small natural cavities to highly organised colonies that may occupy large territories and consist of millions of individuals. Larger colonies consist of various castes of sterile, wingless females, most of which are workers (ergates), as well as soldiers (dinergates) and other specialised groups. Nearly all ant colonies also have some fertile males called drones (aner) and one or more fertile females called queens (gynes). The colonies are described as superorganisms because the ants appear to operate as a unified entity, collectively working together to support the colony.
File:Blackants-bredcrust-tokyo-may2015.webm(video) Ants gathering foodAnts have colonised almost every landmass on Earth. The only places lacking indigenous ants are Antarctica and a few remote or inhospitable islands. Ants thrive in most ecosystems and may form 15–25% of the terrestrial animal biomass. Their success in so many environments has been attributed to their social organisation and their ability to modify habitats, tap resources, and defend themselves. Their long co-evolution with other species has led to mimetic, commensal, parasitic, and mutualistic relationships.
Ant societies have division of labour, communication between individuals, and an ability to solve complex problems. These parallels with human societies have long been an inspiration and subject of study. Many human cultures make use of ants in cuisine, medication, and rituals. Some species are valued in their role as biological pest control agents. Their ability to exploit resources may bring ants into conflict with humans, however, as they can damage crops and invade buildings. Some species, such as the red imported fire ant (Solenopsis invicta), are regarded as invasive species, establishing themselves in areas where they have been introduced accidentally.

The 3D model  is 3D printable.The laser cut version will be uploaded soon.There is also a keyshot rendering file containing the texture.Overview:The Yokosuka K5Y (九三式中間練習機, Kyūsanshikichūkanrenshūki, Type 93 Intermediate Training Aircraft, Allied reporting name: Willow) was a two-seat unequal-span biplane trainer that served in the Imperial Japanese Navy during World War II. Due to its bright orange paint scheme (applied to all Japanese military trainers for visibility), it earned the nickname aka-tombo, or red dragonfly, after a type of insect common throughout Japan.
A K5Y of the Kamikaze Special Attack Corps 3rd Ryuko Squadron was credited with sinking the destroyer USS Callaghan on July 29, 1945, the last US warship lost to kamikaze attack during the war.The aircraft was based on the Yokosuka Navy Type 91 Intermediate Trainer, but stability problems led to a redesign by Kawanishi in 1933. It entered service in 1934 as Navy Type 93 Intermediate Trainer K5Y1 with fixed tail-skid landing gear, and remained in use throughout the war. Floatplane types K5Y2 and K5Y3 were also produced. After the initial 60 examples by Kawanishi, production was continued by Watanabe (556 aircraft built), Mitsubishi (60), Hitachi (1,393), First Naval Air Technical Arsenal (75), Nakajima (24), Nippon (2,733), and Fuji (896), for a total of 5,770. These aircraft were the mainstay of Imperial Japanese Navy Air Service's flight training, and as intermediate trainers, they were capable of performing demanding aerobatic maneuvers. Two further land-based versions, the K5Y4 with a 358 kW (480 hp) Amakaze 21A engine and the K5Y5 with a 384 kW (515 hp) Amakaze 15, were projected but never built.

description_text:
Round Cork Coaster Stencil
Hi Everyone,
I designed these stencils to clip onto a round cork coaster (100mm) so you don't have to worry about the stencil moving around.
To use: Easily make tile coasters with these stencils. Simply paint the background that you want (wait for it to dry). 
Then clip one these stencils over the top. To add to you design and wallop you’re done!
The stencil maybe a little hard to get off, so gently pull up the corners in order to get them off.
If you want them bigger simply enlarge them in your slicer program.
• Please note that if you make them smaller you may lose details of the stencil,
• Please check your slicer program preview and check your layers. As the cutter maybe      better if it is resized bigger.• Print times will vary depending on your settings
Care: • Wash in cold soap water to keep them clean.• Do not put in hot water or it will warp• Do not place stencil in hot areas/ direct sunlight or it will warp
The stencil size is 101mmx101mm

description_text:
Jelly Candy Molding - Gummy Mould05 files included in this pack, as shown in second image:Base Model, x1 Negative, x1 Positive, x8 Negative, x8 Positive.

  - The base model is just a demo of the final candy

  - The negative pieces can be used directly as molds

  - The positive pieces can be used to create negative silicon molds

These molds can be used for jelly candies, chocolate, fondant, and any other material you'd like to try as a common mold.
I can create customized moldings, so feel free to contact me about it.
The sizes are pre-set small (usually around 20mm the final single candy) but you can resize all the molds as you'd like, quality won't change if you resize it bigger or smaller.Quality will change only based on your printer.
IMPORTANT: if you use the 3d printed model directly for candy, be aware if the material you use can have contact with foods.
Easy Printing (one side is full flat)No Support Required
Didn't test print it, but if I did, I would use this Cura settings on my Ender 3 Pro, printing in PLA:-Dynamic Quality: 0.16mm (or 0.12mm)-Printing Temperature: 200 (230 for V-Silk)-Build Plate Temperature: 70-Speed: 35 mm/s-Build Plate Adhesion Type: BrimBut feel free to change and use the settings you prefer.
I would highly recommend printing on Resin if you want high details in small pieces.

The Black Widow 3D Model: A Detailed OverviewThe Black Widow 3D model is a stunning representation of a deadly yet captivating arachnid, designed with meticulous attention to detail and realism. This lifelike model serves not only as a visual spectacle but also as a valuable educational tool and a testament to the advancements in 3D modeling technology.

Each segment of the spider, from its sleek black exoskeleton to its distinctive red hourglass marking, is painstakingly recreated to mirror its real-life counterpart accurately.

Schools, museums, and other educational institutions can utilize this model to teach students about arachnids, their role in the ecosystem, and the unique characteristics of black widows specifically.
By allowing viewers to explore the model from every angle, educators can offer a hands-on learning experience that enhances understanding and retention. Additionally, the detailed accuracy of the model provides a valuable reference for studying the anatomy of black widows in depth.
Technological AdvancementsThe creation of the Black Widow 3D model showcases the cutting-edge capabilities of modern 3D modeling technology. Advanced software tools enable designers to sculpt intricate details with precision, bringing virtual creations to life with unprecedented realism.
Moreover, the Black Widow model demonstrates the potential for 3D printing technology to revolutionize the production of educational materials. With the ability to reproduce highly detailed models quickly and efficiently, 3D printing opens up new possibilities for creating interactive learning resources.
In conclusion, the Black Widow 3D model stands as a testament to the intersection of art, science, and technology. Its stunning accuracy and educational value make it a valuable asset for both learning institutions and enthusiasts of 3D art. With its lifelike representation of one of nature's most intriguing creatures, this model invites viewers to appreciate the beauty and complexity of the natural world in a whole new dimension.
